shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Caped wizard character in the upper-left third shooting a jagged zigzag lightning stream that carries envelopes and shopping bags toward the lower right
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans, tight tracking, with an orange underscore-like bar before it; no other text
shots.what_happens: Continuation of the wizard spell montage under 'sales team' (w32): the wizard flies upper-left while a zigzag beam of envelopes, documents and shopping bags fans out and grows larger toward the bottom-right corner over a dark navy field split by lavender/cream jagged bands. Shot is only ~4 frames, so motion between frames is inferred from neighbouring keyframes.
shots.build_rebuild: On a navy background, emit envelope/bag/badge sprites along a jagged polyline path from a character's wand at upper-left, scaling each sprite from 0.2 to 1.5 and translating it toward the bottom-right over ~0.5 s with ease-out, while flat lavender and cream lightning polygons widen behind them.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Wizard at upper-left with the zigzag stream of envelopes, bags and X/plus badges streaming diagonally to the lower right
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
shots.what_happens: Same diagonal spell composition as s032 with new object layout: green and orange envelopes, pink shopping bags and circular X/plus badges burst outward and enlarge as they approach the viewer; aligned with 'sales team,' (w32-w33). One motion event is counted in this shot. Nearly identical framing to s032 suggests the detected cut may be a rapid redraw/boil of the same scene rather than a true camera change.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the s032 setup but re-seed sprite positions and colours on each 2-4 frame segment (a 'boil' cut) so the stream feels hand-animated and energetic while the wizard and line-art background icons stay fixed.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Wizard and the diagonal zigzag beam of envelopes and shopping bags
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
shots.what_happens: Another ~4-frame variant of the spell stream: objects (lime envelope, orange bag, pink plus badge) re-laid along the beam, larger toward the bottom-right; wizard slightly repositioned. Ends as 'team,' (w33) finishes.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a re-seeded variant of the same diagonal sprite burst every 2-4 frames, keeping the wizard anchored at upper-left and the faint outline icons (laptop, open book, cup) fixed in the navy area.

shots.focal_element: Wizard casting the zigzag stream; large orange and pink bags dominate the lower right

shots.what_happens: Variant frame of the same spell burst; more shopping bags and a large envelope with a document appear at the right edge, the beam has widened further. No speech word in this window (between w33 and w34).
shots.build_rebuild: Continue the boil-cut variants while gradually widening the lightning polygons and increasing the share of shopping-bag sprites to suggest leads turning into purchases.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Wizard and the widest version of the zigzag stream filling the lower-right two thirds with bags and envelopes
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
shots.what_happens: Two-frame final variant of the spell burst before the scene changes; objects are largest and most numerous here, a pink polygon intrudes behind the logo top-right. Only a keyframe was available (no contact sheet).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the densest re-seeded sprite layout for 2 frames as the last beat of the burst before cutting to the funnel scene.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Cream cone/funnel with a lime elliptical top, centered on navy, with lavender/cream lightning bolts erupting upward from it
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix; in the 18.5 s sheet frame a pie-chart icon overlaps the wordmark
shots.what_happens: New scene: a centered funnel/cone (like an ice-cream cone or magic hat flipped) with lightning bolts shooting up from its rim. The keyframe shows a bare cone with narrow bolts; the sheet frame at 18.5 s already shows a lime starburst behind the rim, a pink bag above and a pie-chart icon near the logo, so the burst grows within the shot. The x009 impact SFX (18.60 s) lands in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a centered cone with a lime ellipse top on navy, then scale lavender/cream lightning polygons and a lime spiky starburst up from the rim over ~4 frames, timed to an impact SFX.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Centered cone with lime starburst rim and a pink shopping bag rising above it
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix; a pie-chart icon passes behind/over it
shots.what_happens: Two-frame step of the funnel eruption: the lime starburst has appeared behind the rim, wide lightning rays fan out, a pink bag pops up from the cone and a pie-chart badge flies toward the top-right corner. Only a keyframe was available.
shots.build_rebuild: On the second step of the eruption, pop a spiky lime starburst behind the cone rim (scale 0 to 1 with overshoot) and launch a bag and pie-chart sprite upward and outward from the rim.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Cone with a much larger lime starburst and lightning rays filling the frame; bag, hourglass, envelope and pie-chart icons flying out
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
shots.what_happens: Two-frame step where the framing is pushed in/scaled up: the starburst and rays now cover most of the frame and more objects (hourglass, envelope, pie chart) burst out of the cone. Only a keyframe was available, so whether this is a camera push or object scale is not visible.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the whole cone group ~1.2x toward camera and expand the ray polygons to the frame edges while spawning hourglass, envelope and pie-chart sprites from the rim.

shots.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
shots.focal_element: Cone funnel crowned by a lime starburst, swallowing/emitting a swirl of envelopes, calendars, cursors, hourglass, pie charts and plus/check badges
shots.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
shots.what_happens: Held 1.3 s shot under 'convert more customers,' (w34-w36): the cone stays centered while a vortex of work objects (envelopes, calendars, cursors, hourglass, pie charts, bags, check and plus badges) orbits and is drawn into the lime opening; by 20.0 s the view pulls back/tilts so the cone opening reads as a funnel collecting items. Conveys leads being funnelled into customers.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep a centered cone with lime rim and starburst, and animate ~20 icon sprites on spiral paths that converge into the rim ellipse (scale down and fade as they cross it) over ~1.3 s, with lightning rays slowly rotating behind.
